phase_prompt.summary: Initial activation of the monolith, showcasing the interplay of ancient glyphs and advanced geothermal power.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A towering basalt monolith, 12 m tall, carved with intricate Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs that pulse with bioluminescent light, sits in a dimly lit cavern. Embedded within its core is a crystalline core that hums with geothermal energy, surrounded by copper coils, obsidian filaments, and metal conduits. The scene captures the moment of activation, with the monolith releasing a surge of amber light that illuminates the cavern, revealing hidden inscriptions and casting dramatic shadows, rendered in photorealistic cinematic style.
